name: Stormbringer: Invigorating Winds grants silence and interrupt immunity (#2783)
contract: #2783: Invigorating Winds 705661 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 22, DurationIndex 18 = 20000 ms) promises 'granting them immunity to silence and interrupt effects and causes them to take no pushback from damaging attacks'. The spell has exactly two effects, both APPLY_AURA on EffectImplicitTargetA 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY: effect 0 is aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN with EffectBasePoints -1 and DieSides 1, i.e. amount 0 on misc 127 (all schools), a literal no-op; effect 1 is aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK with EffectBasePoints 99 and DieSides 1, i.e. amount 100. The pushback half is native: Spell.cpp:7958-7963 computes delayReduce = 100 + GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK) - 100 = 100 and returns without applying pushback. The immunity half had no carrier at all: neither effect is aura 77 MECHANIC_IMMUNITY, 147 MECHANIC_IMMUNITY_MASK or 39 SCHOOL_IMMUNITY, and no script was registered on 705661. The fix registers aura_ascension_invigorating_winds on 705661, which holds IMMUNITY_MECHANIC for MECHANIC_SILENCE (9) and MECHANIC_INTERRUPT (26) on the aura's own target for the aura's lifetime. Probes: Silence 15487 has Mechanic 9 and Counterspell 2139 has Mechanic 26 in Spell.dbc, and Unit::IsImmunedToSpell (Unit.cpp:10598-10603) tests spellInfo->Mechanic against m_spellImmune[IMMUNITY_MECHANIC]; neither probe carries SPELL_ATTR0_NO_IMMUNITIES (15487 Attributes 2162688 = NOT_SHAPESHIFTED|NO_ACTIVE_DEFENSE, 2139 Attributes 65536). spell_immune is evaluated on the actor, so the ally has to be a player.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: the ally can be silenced before the buff (Silence 15487, Mechanic 9)
BASELINE: the ally can be interrupted before the buff (Counterspell 2139, Mechanic 26)
SETUP: Invigorating Winds is on the ally
BASELINE: the native pushback half resolves to 100 (EffectBasePoints[1] 99 + die roll 1)
BASELINE: the buff lasts the tooltip's 20 s (SpellDuration row 18 = 20000 ms)
DISCRIMINATING: the ally is immune to silence while the buff is up
DISCRIMINATING: the ally is immune to interrupts while the buff is up
CONTROL: the caster gains no immunity, the aura lands on the ally only
SETUP: the buff is gone from the ally
DISCRIMINATING: the silence immunity leaves with the buff
DISCRIMINATING: the interrupt immunity leaves with the buff
